label: Diagram 6
caption: Diagram 6 Schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure for a block of flats (a building that contains more than one dwelling, in this case containing multiple dwellings)
description: Schematic diagram of a block of flats, a light green structure with a triangular roof and white rectangular dwellings in two columns and five storeys. A central vertical black line, labelled at the top "Ducting/ trays in riser", runs down the middle. Horizontal black lines branch from it at several levels, each reaching a small green rectangle within a dwelling on either side. One such rectangle on the middle left is labelled "Network termination point in each dwelling". At the base of the central line a green rectangle is labelled "Common access point". Below the building a horizontal line marks the base; from the common access point a line runs down, then left as a dashed line. A caption below reads: "Gigabit-ready physical infrastructure (ducting) to the distribution point or, where there is no access right up to the distribution point, as close as is reasonably practicable to a distribution point. In some cases, there will be no gigabit-ready physical infrastructure beyond the common access point." A green bottom banner reads "Diagram 6" and "Schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure for a block of flats (a building that contains more than one dwelling, in this case containing multiple dwellings)".
